title: Activation without the app
body_md: Without the app, Pro-finder is activated by sending a programming message to its number; its structure is described in the section on programming the destination numbers. Once the message has been received and the numbers stored, the status LED flashes green and a status message is returned to the sender. Pro-finder is then ready for use.
prev_context: Before this stands connecting the power supply.
next_context: Section 2.5 on saving the Pro-finder number begins.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 14: equivalent in substance, including the green flashing and the returned status message. The content of the programming message is not quoted (BLK-005).
